svg.title: Three masks used in a transformer: src padding, causal, and combined target mask
svg.desc: Shows three mask matrices as grids. Teal cells are allowed positions, red cells are blocked positions. Source padding mask is square src by src, causal mask is lower-triangular tgt by tgt, target mask combines causal with target padding.
svg.text: The three masks used inside a transformer
Teal = allowed (mask = 1, keep score). Red = blocked (mask = 0, score becomes −∞).

g.text: Source: "the cat sat <PAD> <PAD>" (5 positions, last 2 are padding)
Target: "<BOS> le chat <PAD>" (4 positions, last 1 is padding)

svg.text: 1. src_mask — used by encoder self-attention and decoder cross-attention
Shape: (batch, 1, 1, src_len). Blocks only source padding columns.
Every real query token (the, cat, sat)
can attend to every real key token
but the PAD columns are killed.
PAD rows are kept for shape but their
2. Causal mask — used by decoder self-attention
Shape: (1, 1, tgt_len, tgt_len). Lower-triangular. Each position sees only itself and the past.
Position i can only attend to
positions ≤ i. This is what stops
3. tgt_mask — used by decoder self-attention (causal AND target padding)
tgt_mask = causal_mask AND tgt_pad_mask. Blocks both future tokens and target padding.
Same triangle as causal, but the
PAD column is also red. This is
